trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
initialCheckpoint: same isolated 2000-hand v2 Standard checkpoint used by both previous Pro diagnostics; initialization only
referencePolicy: published D03 v2 Standard ONNX, unchanged
hypothesis: FOLD-only preservation restored FOLD but reduced BET RAISE and DRAW three-card decisions, leaving independent-session chip EV indistinguishable from published Standard. Unstratified reference updates may still underweight these rare decisions.
intervention: On distinct real-controller published-Standard demonstrations, reserve 8 BET FOLD, 8 BET RAISE and 4 DRAW-three examples in every 64-decision imitation and per-hand anchor batch. diagnosticRule: Stop at 1200 hands and reject before imitation if any reference action class has fewer distinct examples than its quota. Compare a held-out same-state action audit and unpaired independent sessions across all 40 group/profile cells; report session chip/hand intervals. Do not infer causal EV from shared starting conditions or promote on an ambiguous interval.
promotionRule: No registry or public asset change without separate preregistered product evaluation including cash/MTT, 2/3/6 seats, opponent distributions, actual browser model use, legal action and amount, deadline and fallback.
safety: 5k is a diagnosis stop gate only. S01 v2 remains stopped; other nine Standard games remain gated until all D03 tiers finish.
